basic_info.description: Welcome to modern city living in the heart of San Francisco's North Beach. This elegant 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom with den/office was thoughtfully designed for the city dweller in mind which includes in-unit laundry and deeded parking. Step inside to find a bright, open-concept layout perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Both bedrooms are generously sized with the primary suite offering a private bathroom and ample closet space. Enjoy morning coffee or sunset wine on the shared rooftop deck with iconic city views. All just steps from Washington Square Park, world-class dining, and historic charm. Check-out www.600ChestnutSt.com
